4381-4694-4779-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
4381-4694-4779-7306.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Grumgully.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability, giving it +1/+0 and first strike until end of turn.
Repeat from step 1.

1203-3417.easyPrerequisites: You have more life than an opponent.
1203-3417.description:
Cast Fire Covenant by {1}{B}{R} and paying an amount of life equal to an opponent's life total, dealing that much damage to Ill-Tempered Loner // Howlpack Avenger.
Ill-Tempered Loner // Howlpack Avenger triggers, dealing that much damage to the opponent.

1809-2103-5144.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Returned Pastcaller and exiling Ephemerate.
When Returned Pastcaller enters, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Ephemerate's rebound ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Returned Pastcaller.
When Returned Pastcaller enters, it triggers, returning Ephemerate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

206-1069-1232-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
206-1069-1232-5499.description:
Activate Nemata's first ability by paying {2}{G}, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Saproling.
Activate the Saproling by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

5226-5795-6871-6879.description:
Cast Barkform Harvester by paying {3}.
When Barkform Harvester enters, Haru triggers, targeting Barkform Harvester as it is a land due to Toph.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Barkform Harvester.
When Barkform Harvester dies, Haru triggers, returning Barkform Harvester from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Barkform Harvester enters, Haru triggers, targeting Barkform Harvester as it is a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Lithatog ability.
Repeat from step 3.

851-2653-5702-6973.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
851-2653-5702-6973.description:
Play a land.
When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Mutable Explorer.
When the Mutable Explorer tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the first Mutable Explorer trigger, creating two Mutavault land tokens that enters tapped.
When the Mutavault tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko and Nissa each trigger twice.
Resolve the Nissa triggers, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Mutable Explorer.
Repeat from step 3.

1350-4010-6723-6968.description:
Cast Farmer Cotton by paying at least {4}{G}{W}
When Farmer Cotton enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least four 1/1 Halfling creature tokens and four Food tokens.
Activate Farmer Cotton, four Halflings and four Foods by tapping them, adding {6}{G}{W}{W}.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Farmer Cotton from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
1350-4010-6723-6968.notes: It is recommended to pay at least {1} additional to start to get infinite untapped tokens. This mana will be recuperated throughout the combo.

413-3764-4871.description:
Activate Summoning Station by tapping it, creating a 2/2 Pincher creature token.
When the Pincher enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Pincher.
When the Pincher dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Summoning Station triggers, untapping it.
Repeat.

1020-2034-2866-5705.notablePrerequisites:
One of the artifact creatures must be in your hand while the other is in your graveyard.
You have enough mana to cast the artifact card in your hand.
1020-2034-2866-5705.description:
Cast the artifact creature card in your hand by paying its mana cost.
Glaring Fleshraker's first ability triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield, Glaring Fleshraker's second ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the artifact creature spell, triggering Glaring Fleshraker's second ability, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the artifact creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the artifact creature dies, it triggers, returning the other artifact creature from your graveyard to your hand.
If needed, activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

1329-2178-3661-5256.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1329-2178-3661-5256.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Shield Sphere from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Shield Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Shield Sphere.
When Shield Sphere dies, Emry triggers, untapping Emry.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

428-1694-3090-5361.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to deal exactly two or three damage to an opponent.
Auton Soldier on the battlefield as a copy of Ghyrson Starn.
You have enough mana to cast Harmless Offering.
428-1694-3090-5361.description:
Cast Harmless Offering by paying its mana cost, giving control of Gisela to an opponent.
Deal exactly two or three damage to the opponent, which is reduced to one by Gisela, triggering Ghyrson Starn and Auton Soldier.
Resolve the Ghyrson Starn trigger, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Auton Soldier triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Repeat from step 4.

141-167-2034.description:
Cost Not Dead After All by paying {B}, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Not Dead After All, with the copy targeting Naru Meha
Resolve the copy of Not Dead After All.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Naru Meha, adding {C}{C}.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield with a Wicked Role token attached to it.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Not Dead After All, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Not Dead After All.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Naru Meha, adding {C}{C}.
When Naru Meha dies, it and the Wicked Role token attached to it trigger.
Resolve the Wicked Role trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a Wicked Role token attached to it.
Repeat from step 7.

509-3525-5116.notablePrerequisites:
Idris does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Idris.
509-3525-5116.description:
Activate Idris using Gilded Lotus's ability by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Idris.
Repeat.

2837-3259-4737.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to another creature you control that can attack this turn.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2837-3259-4737.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Captain Lannery Storm as attackers.
Captain Lannery Storm's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Cat creature token with haste due to Jinnie Fay.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Cat token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1770-2226-2543.manaNeeded: {2} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
1770-2226-2543.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{R}{G}{W}.
1770-2226-2543.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}{G}{W}.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters the battlefield, it triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}{G}{W}.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Shivan Wurm by paying {3}{R}{G}.
When Shivan Wurm enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, returning itself and Zacama from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{R}{G}{W}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may use that mana to activate Zacama's other abilities.

147-802-4191.easyPrerequisites: There are applicable target(s) for Snap.
147-802-4191.description:
Cast Snap by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage without paying its mana cost due to Aluren.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Snap, targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Snap copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from the battlefield to your hand and untapping up to two lands you control.
Repeat from step 2.

4013-4659-4840.description:
Spend {2}{C} to activate Eldrazi Displacer's ability targeting Myr Battlesphere.
Myr Battlesphere ETBs, creating 4 Myr tokens.
Sacrifice two tokens to Krark-Clan Ironworks for 4 {C}.
Use the mana to activate Eldrazi Displacer's ability, targeting the Battlesphere.
Repeat for infinite Myr tokens and colorless mana.
